name: cc-agents-kit
description: Guardrails and workflow tooling for Claude Code, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: guard-hooks
plugins.description: Nine defensive hooks: blocks recursive rm on $HOME, download-and-execute pipelines, secrets-file access, path-less formatter runs, credentials in the staged diff, and the two zsh quoting mistakes that fail silently; warns on stale lockfiles, shellcheck findings, and automatic security-review findings after a commit; masks credential-shaped values out of Bash output before the model sees them.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Carry work across sessions and keep the context that carries it lean: hand off a session, export or log what it found, chart an effort too big for one sitting, and audit or garbage-collect your Claude Code config.

plugins.name: repo-gate
plugins.description: What runs between "the code works" and "it is pushed": trunk setup, conventional-commit splitting, dependency vulnerability triage, spell-check and markdownlint triage, and babysitting CI until it is green.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: A function-hook mod that reads each model request's own usage, shows the real context fill above the prompt, vetoes an auto-compact the advisor's double-counted usage would fire, and sends the handoff nudge once at 80%.

plugins.name: quick-look
plugins.description: A function-hook mod that collects the files the agent reads, writes or names, and opens them in macOS Quick Look from /ql or a pane, in any terminal including Warp.
